input.quote: 13.3 Customer may transfer its licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24. Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13 meets the preferred position in full: the subscription grant in 13.1 expressly extends to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (no written-notice condition needed); 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence for paid-up software and Vendor Technology embedded in Deliverables, extending to Affiliates and contractor support; 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured breach after notice and a cure opportunity, so the licence is not revocable at Vendor's discretion; and 14.3 confirms the Section 13.2 perpetual licence covers Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable. No redline required.
